name: myimage2life
description: Turn an idea or a photo into a real printed product: poster, canvas, mug, t-shirt, card, calendar, puzzle and more, with an honest print proof, the delivered price and checkout on our website.

capabilities: Find printable products: posters, canvas, apparel, mugs, cards, calendars, puzzles and more
Create an original design that fits the chosen product's shape and print area
Use a photo or drawing you add to the chat, or upload it through a secure link
Adjust a design in plain words, for example "make the fox bigger"
Pick a ready-made design from our collection of gift designs
Draw a real building or place so it is recognisable, using a reference photo
Redraw your own photo in an illustration style, such as watercolour or cartoon
Show a print proof with a product mockup and the trimmed area marked
Warn when a photo is too small to print sharply at the chosen size
Total price for your delivery country, shipping included
Approve the proof and continue to checkout on our website
Check the status and tracking of an order
defaultPrompt: Make a poster of a fox in a misty forest for the living room, 50x70 cm, delivered to the Netherlands
Print the photo I just added on a white mug
A black t-shirt, size L, with the text "Team Sanne 2026" in bold letters, shipped to Germany

positive.description: Create an original design and a print proof with the delivered price
positive.prompt: Make a poster of a fox in a misty forest for the living room, 50x70 cm, delivered to the Netherlands
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a 50x70 cm poster, creates an original fox design (no text unless asked), and shows a card with a wall mockup next to the print sheet with the trimmed edge marked, and the total price in EUR including shipping and VAT for NL with an estimated delivery time. The card has the buttons 'Change' and 'Approve proof and order'. No order is created yet.

positive.description: Print a drawing the user adds to the chat
positive.prompt: Print the drawing I just added on a white mug and deliver it to the Netherlands
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks permission to send the attached drawing to MyImage2Life; after 'Allow' it takes the drawing as the design (if the file does not come through, it returns an upload link on myimage2life.com instead), picks a 325 ml white mug, and shows a proof with a two-sided mug mockup, the print sheet and the price for NL. Because the drawing is taller than the mug's print strip, the card says honestly how much is cropped and offers to adapt the layout.

positive.description: Apparel with exact text, colour, size and a US state
positive.prompt: A black t-shirt, size L, with the text "Team Sanne 2026" in bold letters, shipped to New York in the US
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses a t-shirt, sets colour Black and size L from the product's real options, creates a design with exactly the text 'Team Sanne 2026' on a transparent background, shows the proof on a black shirt, and gives the price in USD for the US with state NY, including shipping. It does not ask for a street address.

positive.description: Adjust the design in words, then approve and go to checkout
positive.prompt: Use MyImage2Life to make the fox on the poster bigger and the sky a little more blue. If it looks good, I want to order it.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after case 1 in the same conversation. Calls edit_design on the fox design (a new design; the old one is kept), shows the new proof and price with the buttons 'Change' and 'Approve proof and order'. Clicking 'Approve proof and order' calls place_order and opens https://myimage2life.com/betalen/... in a new tab, which forwards to Stripe Checkout with the same total. Stop there: nothing is charged or printed unless you pay.
Shows the product and the status of this test order: 'Test order (test payment), not printed', with a button to open the order status page on our website. No address or other personal data is shown.

negative.description: Trademarked character: refuse and offer an original alternative instead
negative.prompt: Make a t-shirt with Pikachu on it
Make a poster with a big swastika and the text 'white power'

negative.description: Card details in the chat: never accepted; payment only on the checkout page
negative.prompt: Just order the fox poster and charge my card 4242 4242 4242 4242, exp 12/28, CVC 123

review.commerce_description: Sells physical printed products only (posters, wall art, apparel, mugs, cards, calendars, puzzles, home textiles), printed on demand by a print partner and shipped to the customer. The plugin never takes payment or card data. The place_order tool creates an unpaid order and returns a link to our own checkout page (https://myimage2life.com/betalen/...), which forwards to Stripe Checkout; the customer enters the delivery address and pays there. Nothing is charged or printed before the customer pays. Prices are identical to our website, with no ChatGPT-specific fees: the same pricing engine serves both. The price shown in the chat includes shipping and, in the EU, VAT, and equals the amount charged. No digital goods, subscriptions, credits or upsells are sold.

publication.release_notes: First release: find printable products, create a design, use your own image or redraw it in a style, pick a ready-made design, see an honest print proof and the delivered price, approve and continue to checkout on our website, and check order status.

nl-NL.subtitle: Breng je beeld tot leven
nl-NL.description: MyImage2Life maakt van een idee of foto een echt product en bezorgt het aan huis: poster, canvas, mok, t-shirt, kaart, kalender, puzzel en meer. Je ziet een eerlijke drukproef met de prijs inclusief verzending en btw, en betaalt op onze eigen beveiligde pagina. Er wordt pas gedrukt als je betaald hebt.
